name: BanditRL.OnlineConvex.realEpigraph_toReal
statement: theorem realEpigraph_toReal (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) : realEpigraph f = {p : E × ℝ | p.1 ∈ effectiveDomain f ∧ (f p.1).toReal ≤ p.2}
